provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_341: H_X=[circ(a)|circ(b)], H_Z=[circ(b)^T|circ(a)^T], with a={2,64,74,110,178,240,308,322} (weight 8, invariant under j->32j mod 341: fixed points 110, 308 and pair-orbits {2,64},{74,322},{178,240}) and b=a(x^4)={4j mod 341 : j in a}={8,30,99,209,256,265,278,296}, a Frobenius image with the same zero set. Shared divisor (x+1) * six full-order decics of x^341-1 (degree 61), so k=122; both check weights 8 (w=16). First hit of a weight-8 symmetric-word sampler (method in the note); 2M-trial RIS ladder bound 86, then fresh-seed accelerated RIS trials (lightest logical: weight 85, found independently in three 1M-trial chunks).

search_budget.tool: symmetric-word sampler with GF(1024) zero sets + gf2_fast accelerator
